titulo.en: To believe or not to believe

intro.en: Religions and beliefs, the Catholic vocabulary that fills Spanish life and language, and a few words of philosophy.

el alma.nota: Feminine, but el alma in the singular, like el agua.

texto.en:
**Religions.** **El cristianismo** (**el catolicismo**, **el protestantismo**), **el islam**, **el judaísmo**, **el budismo**, **el hinduismo**. The adjectives are not written with a capital: **católico**, **musulmán**, **judío**, **budista**.

**Positions.** **Ser creyente**, **practicante** or **no practicante**, **ateo**, **agnóstico**. **Tener fe.** **Convertirse al** budismo. **Un Estado laico** has no official religion.

**Catholic vocabulary.** It is everywhere in Spain, even among non-believers. **La iglesia** (the building) and **la Iglesia** (the institution). **El cura** or **el sacerdote**, **el obispo**, **el papa**, **la monja**, **el monje**. **La misa**, **el bautizo**, **la comunión**, **la confesión**. **Rezar** una **oración**. **El pecado**, **el cielo**, **el infierno**, **el alma**, **el milagro**.

**The calendar.** **La Navidad**, **los Reyes Magos** (6 January, when Spanish children get their presents), **la Semana Santa** with its **procesiones**, **el santo** of each person.

**Religion in the language.** Dozens of everyday phrases keep it alive: **¡Dios mío!** **Gracias a Dios.** **Si Dios quiere.** **Ojalá** (from Arabic: may God will it). **Adiós** (to God). **Ser un santo** (to be very patient). **Hacer un milagro** (to manage the impossible). **Llegar y besar el santo** (to succeed at the first attempt).

**Philosophy.** **La razón** and **la fe**. **El pensamiento**, **el conocimiento**, **la ética**. **Razonar**, **reflexionar sobre**, **plantearse** una pregunta. **El sentido de la vida.** **El más allá.**

**Oración** has two meanings: a prayer and, in grammar, a sentence.

frases.es: España no tiene, según su Constitución, religión oficial, y cada vez menos españoles se declaran practicantes.
frases.en: Spain has, according to its Constitution, no official religion, and fewer and fewer Spaniards say they are practising believers.

frases.es: Sin embargo, durante la Semana Santa las calles de cientos de ciudades se llenan de procesiones.
frases.en: However, during Holy Week the streets of hundreds of cities fill with processions.
analisis: las calles de cientos de ciudades

frases.es: Miles de personas cargan durante horas con imágenes que pesan toneladas, muchas de ellas sin haber pisado una iglesia en todo el año.
frases.en: Thousands of people carry for hours images that weigh tons, many of them without having set foot in a church all year.

frases.es: Algunos lo hacen por fe, otros por una promesa, y bastantes porque lo hicieron su padre y su abuelo.
frases.en: Some do it out of faith, others because of a promise, and quite a few because their father and grandfather did it.

frases.es: Hay ateos convencidos que lloran al paso de la Virgen de su barrio.
frases.en: There are convinced atheists who weep as the Virgin of their neighbourhood goes by.
analisis: al paso de la Virgen de su barrio

frases.es: Quien quiera entenderlo no debería preguntar por la religión, sino por la pertenencia.
frases.en: Whoever wants to understand it should not ask about religion but about belonging.

frases.es: Para muchos, la procesión no es tanto una oración como la manera de decir de dónde son.
frases.en: For many, the procession is not so much a prayer as a way of saying where they are from.

pregunta.en: According to the text, why do many non-believers take part in the processions?

Out of tradition and belonging.en: Porque lo hicieron su padre y su abuelo.

Because they are paid.en: The text does not say that.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what is a procession for many people?

A way of saying where they are from.en: La manera de decir de dónde son.

A tourist show.en: The text does not say that.

bloques.correcta: A way of saying where they are from

a lazy state.en: Laico has nothing to do with lazy.

bloques.correcta: a state with no official religion

El.en: Feminine nouns beginning with stressed a take el in the singular.

La.en: Before stressed a, the singular article is el.

Lo.en: Lo is neuter and never goes with a noun.

bloques.frase: Aprobó a la primera: llegar y besar el santo.

texto.en: He passed first time: instant success.
He passed first: he arrived and kissed the saint.

explicacion.en: The idiom means succeeding at the first attempt.

texto.en: He passed thanks to a miracle.

explicacion.en: The idiom is about succeeding at once.

traduccion.en: Fewer and fewer Spaniards say they are practising believers.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an essay on the place of religious traditions in a society where fewer and fewer people believe.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain aloud a religious or traditional festival of your country to someone who knows nothing about it.
